newsitem.title: FRANCE: Comptoirs Modernes sees better results.
newsitem.headline: Comptoirs Modernes sees better results.

text.p: Comptoirs Modernes said it expected turnover to rise 10 to 12 percent and profits to rise by more than that amount in 1996.

"The months of July and August were good, we expect a rise in turnover in line with that of the first half, between 10 percent and 12 percent and growth in net attributable profits after amortisation of capital gains, slightly better than the rise in turnover," said company chairman Jean-Claude Plassart.
In the first half, the company announced net profit after amortisation of capital gains of 190 million francs, up nine percent.
